## Problem statement

What problem would this solve? Describe the use case — don't jump to the solution.

## Proposed solution

What would you like Sinopebase to do?

## Alternatives considered

What workarounds exist today? Why are they insufficient?

## Scope

- [ ] SDK (`sinopebase` client)
- [ ] REST API (`/rest/v1`)
- [ ] Auth API (`/auth/v1`)
- [ ] Realtime (`/realtime/v1`)
- [ ] Storage (`/storage/v1`)
- [ ] Admin UI (`/_/`)
- [ ] Edge Functions
- [ ] Mastra / AI
- [ ] CLI / build tooling
- [ ] Documentation

## Additional context

Links, references, how Supabase or PocketBase handles this.
